executiveSummary.prose: In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe

In the Everyuth range, Scrub holds ~49% share (Rank 1) and Peel Off holds ~75% (Rank 1), while Facial Cleansing holds ~8% (Rank 5).
Complan holds 4% fat spread share (Rank 4).
Nutralite is Rank 1 in fat spread by company estimates.

RiteBite and Max Protein are Rank 1 in Nutrition & Protein Bar and Protein Cookies & Chips by company estimates. d) International Markets Formulations (11% of Q4 FY26 revenue): The company's international markets division comprises of the Emerging Markets (selected territories in Asia Pacific, Middle East, Africa and Latin America) and Europe (France, Spain and the UK).
